cohort: 898 women with gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) seen between 1991 and 2011 at a tertiary care diabetes center in Chennai, south India, with follow-up data available for 174 women.
finding: Over 90% of the women with GDM who were followed up developed type 2 diabetes within 10 years of delivery.
mod_finding: 65% of the women underwent a cesarean section.
